criterion: Quarantine files with a measured single-file run over 30 s, plus measured-red files whose assertions or waiting failures require repair before returning to the blocking suite.
source: The ten green-slow entries the integration candidate added were re-measured on 2026-11-26 on box madarch-0039-fix2 (agent-linux-02, 4 vCPU, 8 GiB, image madarch-3) at that candidate's HEAD, one file at a time inside scripts/plugin-sandbox-cgroup.sh's delegated cgroup; those seconds are that machine's whole-file runs and are roughly three times a runner's. The runner measurements of run 45758277151 (ubuntu-24.04, ede4936b1) stay in each entry's defect text. Entries older than this measurement keep the note their own source names.
note: The ten integration entries record the candidate's own measurement: on one box the fixture fill costs 8.1 times main's (155.6 s against main's median 19.3 s for the unchanged fixture of test/status-work.test.ts), so what these files measure is the fill, not the setup around it. Where a file stopped at a bound it names, its seconds are that run's wall time and therefore a floor. test/db-schema-path.test.ts was re-run with its two 300 s bounds raised to 900 s and finished 5 of 5 cases in 507 s, so the PARENT_DELETE_RESTRICTED refill failure reported from an earlier box does not reproduce at this candidate.

files.replacement: The cost is the 0039 fill's implementation, not this fixture's setup: on box madarch-0039-fix2 the unchanged fixture of test/status-work.test.ts fills in 155.6 s against main's median 19.3 s (8.1x; 14 824 against 1 522 db.statement spans, 98.8 s against 4.6 s inside PostgreSQL), and its trace puts 12 438 of 14 824 statements and 53.1 s in the engine's own bookkeeping (the run vertex read 774 times, units 598 times, write rights rebound 154 times in 10.9 s), 20.5 s in a deferred graph check wider than decision 0039 item 28 asks, and 37.1 s in the plugins' own facts (76.1 s of plugin.unit wall time double-counts 49.3 s of host operation apply; plugins' own work is roughly 20 s).
